analysis: Examined all supplied units. (1) docs/provider/cli-reference.md: the head excerpts show only a doc change at the GLM video bullet ("constant or variable frame rate") plus the date bump. The surrounding text is unchanged, including the daemon env passthrough list, the App Attest worker opt-in, the fan helper and cache variables. No security controls or trust-boundary text are altered. (2) GLM5NextMediaRoutingTests.swift: the patch adds a test-only tokenizer and a test that decodes two OpenRouter readiness videos (MOV and MP4) through the scheduler. It adds a CryptoKit import and a SHA-256 pin check of test resource files. This is test code and adds no production attack surface. The test loads fixtures from libs/mlx-swift-lm/Tests/MLXLMTests/Resources/MiMoOpenRouter/, with a #filePath-relative path walk. (3) The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer moves from 7bed8216 to 6aef0a5d. The submodule contents are not supplied. The doc claim that variable-frame-rate QuickTime video is now accepted implies a media-ingest and decoding change in the submodule, with the test showing the grid shape and span expectations. That change touches untrusted consumer media parsing (the decode path, bounded ingest, TB-007 and T-050 territory), and its resource, frame and memory bounds and temp-file handling cannot be verified from this batch. This is an unverified contract, not evidence of a regression. The next pass should review the submodule diff for VFR decode bounds (frame count, duration, pixel budget), for no plaintext video written to temp files (T-050), and for the GLM5NextVisionBudget reservation still covering VFR clips. No findings are raised, but deeper review of the submodule delta is advisable.
